import numpy as np
def update_edge_distance(edge_distance, local_opt_tour, edge_n_used):
    updated_edge_distance = np.copy(edge_distance)
    n = len(local_opt_tour)
    u_nodes = local_opt_tour
    v_nodes = np.roll(local_opt_tour, -1)
    w_nodes = np.roll(local_opt_tour, -2)
    dists_fwd = edge_distance[u_nodes, v_nodes]
    dists_bwd = edge_distance[v_nodes, u_nodes]
    dists_next = edge_distance[v_nodes, w_nodes]
    dists_cross = edge_distance[u_nodes, w_nodes]
    usage_fwd = edge_n_used[u_nodes, v_nodes]
    usage_bwd = edge_n_used[v_nodes, u_nodes]
    usage_cross = edge_n_used[u_nodes, w_nodes]
    usage_synth = 0.4 * usage_fwd + 0.4 * usage_bwd + 0.2 * usage_cross
    curvature = np.abs(dists_fwd + dists_next - dists_cross) / (dists_fwd + dists_next + dists_cross + 1e-8)
    dir_variance = np.abs(dists_fwd - dists_bwd) / (dists_fwd + dists_bwd + 1e-8)
    blended_dist = 0.65 * dists_fwd + 0.35 * dists_cross
    max_tour_dist = np.max(dists_fwd) + 1e-8
    rel_dist_scale = blended_dist / max_tour_dist
    utilities = (blended_dist * (1.0 + rel_dist_scale)) / (1.0 + usage_synth)
    max_util = np.max(utilities) + 1e-8
    normalized_util = utilities / max_util
    sigmoid_force = 1.0 / (1.0 + np.exp(-14.0 * (normalized_util - 0.5)))
    non_linear_scale = np.power(1.0 + curvature, 2.0) * np.exp(dir_variance)
    force_fwd = sigmoid_force * non_linear_scale * (1.0 + dir_variance)
    force_bwd = sigmoid_force * non_linear_scale * (1.0 - 0.5 * dir_variance)
    force_cross = 0.25 * sigmoid_force * non_linear_scale
    np.add.at(updated_edge_distance, (u_nodes, v_nodes), force_fwd)
    np.add.at(updated_edge_distance, (v_nodes, u_nodes), force_bwd)
    np.add.at(updated_edge_distance, (u_nodes, w_nodes), force_cross)
    return updated_edge_distance
